none: PAS NLM-7FC10F: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), probably Trier mint Two Victories issue of 347-348, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right; hair on crown of head stands up in vaguely Celtic fashion. Obverse inscription: [--]NSTAN [---]. Reverse description: Two Victories facing each other holding wreaths, an ivy-leaf point downwards between them. Reverse inscription: [VICTORIAE] DD AVGGQ NN. Diameter (long axis): 16.3mm, Weight: 0.80gms, die axis: 12
